pageSubtitle: GPU Kokoro via the built-in preset, or any OpenAI-compatible TTS (including CPU Kokoro)
siteNameHint: Shown in the shell and as the document title. Leave blank to use the default. Max {{max}} characters.
faviconHint: Use .ico, .png, .webp, or .svg. Replaces the default tab icon after upload.
libraryBannersHint: Wide images (16∶9 works well). PNG or JPEG. Remove a banner here if you no longer want it offered for libraries.
resetCustomizationDetail: Clears the custom site name, tab icon, and all uploaded library banners. Libraries that used an uploaded banner switch back to their built-in banner.
probeOk: TTS test succeeded — the engine returned audio for a sample line
probeFail: TTS test failed — check the provider, URL, and that the service is running
kokoroDesc: Targets the backend KOKORO_TTS_URL (intended for GPU Kokoro-FastAPI, e.g. repo docker-compose). OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech.
customDesc: Any OpenAI-compatible TTS — use this for CPU Kokoro, remote APIs, or other engines.
baseUrlHintCustom: Use scheme + host + port (e.g. http://localhost:8882 from Windows, or http://kokoro-nookline:8880 from the Nookline backend container). If you paste …/v1 like other OpenAI-compatible apps, that is fine — Nookline strips it before calling /v1/audio/speech.
apiKeyHintCustom: Some TTS services require an API key to generate TTS responses — optional if your service does not require one.
voiceIdHint: Kokoro voices: use names from /v1/audio/voices. OpenAI: alloy, echo, etc.
chunkSectionHint: Controls how long each TTS request is for EPUB/PDF. Larger max chunks mean fewer API calls but longer latency per chunk.
chunkMinInfo: Minimum size of a text chunk (characters) before the splitter prefers to end on a sentence boundary. Lower values mean shorter clips and more chunks per page.
chunkMaxInfo: Maximum length of a chunk. The splitter looks for the last period between Min and Max. Larger values mean fewer TTS requests per page but longer latency per clip.
chunkPeriodInfo: If no period appears by Max, the splitter scans this many extra characters past Max to find a sentence end, reducing awkward mid-sentence breaks.
chunkValidationNumbers: Min, Max, and Extra must be whole numbers (digits only).
chunkValidationMax: Max must be at least Min + 10 and at most 50000.
modelIdHint: Kokoro: kokoro. OpenAI TTS: tts-1 or tts-1-hd.
customTtsModelHint: Model parameter sent to the speech API. This is not the same as the voice model.
customVoiceModelHint: Identifier for the voice (e.g. Kokoro af_heart or OpenAI alloy).
resetTtsDetail: Restores the built-in Kokoro preset, clears the custom URL and any stored API key, and resets speed, chunking, and AI reader bar options to their defaults.
aiReaderPanelSectionHint: What to show in the floating reader bar while listening.
readerShowPageLabel: Show PDF page number (current page, and total pages when known)
readerStripPdfMarginsLabel: Strip repeating PDF headers and footers for TTS
readerStripPdfMarginsHint: Uses patterns detected when each PDF was added (page numbers, title bars, etc.). Only affects spoken text in the AI reader, not the on-page PDF.
